newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: HBG unit orders Dfl 95 mln dredger.
newsitem.headline: HBG unit orders Dfl 95 mln dredger.

text.p: Construction firm Hollandsche Beton Groep NV said on Wednesday its HAM dredging unit had placed a 95 million guilder order with Dutch shipyard Verolme to build a 13,700 tonne suction hopper dredger.
"The new vessel will replace older tonnage in the fleet," HBG said.
The order was placed by HAM's French Sodranord operation, HBG said. HAM is due to take delivery of the new vessel in mid-September 1998.
The new vessel, HAM 316, measures over 128 metres in length and will have a loading capacity of 9,600 tonnes, HBG said.
HAM's fleet currently comprises 17 hoppers. The company currently has another suction hopper dredger on order, due for delivery next spring.
